properties.discussion:
A trough of low pressure located several hundred miles northeast of  Bermuda is moving quickly north-northeastward at 20 to 25 mph. The  system's circulation remains elongated and its associated shower and  thunderstorm activity is also elongated. Environmental conditions  are becoming more hostile over the system, and its chances for  development are decreasing. 
 Formation chance through 48 hours...low...20 percent. 
 Formation chance through 7 days...low...20 percent.

An area of low pressure located along a tropical wave a few hundred  miles south-southwest of the Cabo Verde Islands continues to produce  showers and thunderstorms displaced southwest of its center. This  activity has changed little in organization this evening, but  environmental conditions remain somewhat favorable for gradual  development over the next couple of days. A tropical depression is  likely to form over the next day or two as the system moves westward  to west-northwestward across the eastern and central tropical  Atlantic, though environmental conditions are forecast to become  less favorable for development by this weekend. 
 Formation chance through 48 hours...high...70 percent. 
 Formation chance through 7 days...high...70 percent.

A tropical wave located well to the south of southwestern Mexico is  producing a large area of showers and thunderstorms. This system is  gradually becoming better organized, and environmental conditions  appear favorable for continued development. A tropical depression is  expected to form in the next two or three days while it moves  generally west-northwestward at 10 to 15 mph, well offshore of  Mexico. 
 Formation chance through 48 hours...medium...60 percent. 
 Formation chance through 7 days...high...90 percent.

An area of low pressure could form this weekend well south of  southern Mexico. Environmental conditions should support some  gradual development of this system, and a tropical depression could  form by early next week while it moves westward to  west-northwestward at 10 to 15 mph. 
 Formation chance through 48 hours...low...near 0 percent. 
 Formation chance through 7 days...medium...50 percent.

A weak and small area of low pressure located well to the  east-southeast of the Hawaiian Islands is producing some  disorganized showers and thunderstorms. Environmental conditions  appear conducive for  gradual development, and a tropical depression  is likely to form late this week or early this weekend while the  system drifts northeastward, then turns to the west-northwest. 
 Formation chance through 48 hours...medium...40 percent. 
 Formation chance through 7 days...high...70 percent.

An area of low pressure could form well south of the Hawaiian  Islands late this week or over the weekend.  Some gradual  development is possible by early next week while the system moves  slowly to the west-northwest, well south-southwest of the Hawaiian  Islands. 
 Formation chance through 48 hours...low...near 0 percent. 
 Formation chance through 7 days...low...20 percent.
